title: Wednesday's big stock stories: What’s likely to move the market in the next trading session
raw_text: Stocks @ Night is a daily newsletter delivered after hours, giving you a first look at tomorrow and last look at today. Sign up for free to receive it directly in your inbox. Here's what CNBC TV's producers were watching as the Dow Industrials briefly topped 52,000 and what's on the radar for the next session. Fed decision day It'll be the first big decision from the new chairman of the Federal Reserve, Kevin Warsh. The rate decision is due out at 2 p.m. ET, followed by a news conference at 2:30 p.m. Going into Wednesday, the U.S. 10-year Treasury note is yielding 4.43%. The two-year yield is at 4.05%. The one-year yield is at 3.84%. The six-month Treasury bill is yielding 3.8%. The three-month T-bill yield is at 3.72%. The one-month T-bill yield is at 3.63%. The iShares 0-5 Year High Yield Corporate Bond ETF (SHYG) has a dividend yield of 6.99%. The iShares iBoxx High Yield Corporate Bond ETF (HYG) has a dividend yield of 5.89%. The State Street SPDR Bloomberg High Yield Bond ETF (JNK) has a dividend of 6.59%. The Fidelity Corporate Bond ETF (FCOR) has a dividend of 4.53%. The KraneShares Asia Pacific High Income USD Bond ETF (KHYB) has a dividend of 8.8% if you're willing to buy bonds outside of the U.S. with different tax consequences. CNBC's senior economics reporter Steve Liesman will be covering every second and every word. US10Y YTD mountain 10-year Treasury yield in 2026 Oil Brent and West Texas Intermediate futures are now both below $80 a barrel. They are both down 27% in the last month. The S & P Energy Sector is now down 13% from the March 27 high. Gasoline futures are down 21% in a month. The average cost of a gallon of unleaded in the great state of New Jersey is now $4.08, according to AAA, but you can find it for under the $4 mark. In Texas, it's at about $3.50. The market Three-day win streaks have ended for the Nasdaq Composite , Nasdaq 100 and Russell 2000 . The Dow Transports are now down 10% from the 52-week high. All major indexes are above their 50-day and 200-day moving averages. Thanks to CNBC market data man Chris Hayes for the stats and facts. .IXIC 5D mountain The Nasdaq Composite in the past five trading days Reporting before the bell live on 'Squawk Box' CarMax will release numbers in the 6 a.m. hour. The stock is up almost 25% in three months. The stock is down 27% from where it stood at the 52-week high back in July 2025. Jabil will release numbers in the 8 a.m. hour. The stock is up 45% in three months. It hit a high on Monday, but it's down 6% since hitting that high mark. Squawk Box will have it all live with Becky Quick, Joe Kernen and Andrew Ross Sorkin. AWS Summit CNBC will be watching for news Wednesday on Amazon's AWS. Shares of Amazon are up 3.1% in two days, but they are down 9% in June. The stock is 11.7% from the May 5 high. AMZN 5D mountain Amazon in the past five days SpaceX A major resupply mission is set to come to an end at 8:08 a.m. on the East Coast. That's 5:08am out West when the vehicle is expected to splash down off the golden coast of California. SpaceX settled above the $200 a share mark on Tuesday. CrowdStrike's annual meeting CNBC TV's Seema Mody will be watching and reporting as news comes out. The cybersecurity company's stock is down 13.5% from the high hit on June 1. CrowdStrike shares are up about 45% in 2026 and up 60% in three months.
